info.title: Amiigo
info.author: CompSciOrBust
info.details:
Amiigo is a GUI for Emuiibo and a EmuGUIibo alternative that runs directly on the switch.

Controls
Up / Down on Dpad to move up and down the list.

A to select a Amiibo from the list.

X toggles emulation state.

Y moves on to the next Amiibo.

B enters the Amiigo Maker. Press B again to go back to the Amiibo selection UI.

You can also use the touch screen to select an Amiibo by tapping on a item in the list, tapping the emulation status rectangle will toggle the emulation state, and tapping the currently selected Amiibo on the top rectangle will move on to the next Amiibo.

changelog:
v2.5.0
Changes to Amiigo:

Features

- Amiibo image saving toggle — Option added to control whether downloaded amiibo images are saved to disk.
- Amiibo image previews — When selecting an Amiibo in the My Amiibo list an image preview is shown if an image is available.
- Generate all amiibos at once — New buttons in both the Settings UI and the Amiigo Store context menu to generate every amiibo in bulk.
- Full settings UI overhaul — Settings reorganised into submenus with a dedicated theming menu, a reinstall Emuiibo button, a dropdown for category options, and a checkbox for the random UUID setting.
- Multi-language support — UI text is now fully localised; English (en-GB), Spanish (es), Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans/zh-CN), and Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant/zh-TW) are included.
- Automatic image resizing — Downloaded images are resized for compatibility with Tesla / Ultrahand.
- Amiibo name from JSON — Amiibo display names are now read directly from the amiibo JSON data.
- Re-introduced the ability to update the local amiibo API cachie from the internet.
- O(1) series data extraction — Amiibo series lookup replaced with a constant-time function.

Bug Fixes

- Emuiibo install now reboots the console — After installing, the app prompts to reboot so the sysmodule loads correctly.
- Emuiibo path buffer size — Passed the correct buffer size to SetActiveVirtualAmiibo.
- Misc networking and utility fixes — Corrected edge cases in download logic and amiibo path handling.

Changes to Arriba:

Features

- Wrapped text element — New WrapText element that automatically breaks text onto multiple lines when it exceeds a configurable pixel width.
- Improved Chinese font support — Extended the font rasteriser to better handle CJK glyphs, with fallback glyph resolution for characters not covered by the primary face.
- O(1) tag lookups — findObjectsByTag is now backed by a hash structure.
- Shader uniform location cache — Uniform locations looked up once and cached per shader.
- Faster mat4 multiplication — Matrix multiply logic reverted to old version, 11% faster at -O0.
- Steam Deck / SteamOS support (Not used for Amiigo) — Added an SDL-based input backend so Arriba can run on Linux.


Bug Fixes

- UI object lifecycle — UIObject construction/destruction made fully explicit.
- InertialList stability — Suppressed a lag spike during list load, and corrected several edge-case scrolling behaviours.
- Vsync frame cap — Vsync enabled on the swap buffer call.

v2.4.1
- Fixed bug in which the name field of the JSON output was saved as an array of bytes instead of a string
  - Any Amiibos generated with version 2.4.0 will not work and must be regenerated.
  - This bug only affected version 2.4.0 and any Amiibos generated with prior versions are fine.

2.4.0
Changes to Amiigo:

Status bar now highlights when a status change occurs
Emuiibo version is now shown in the settings menu
Changed symbols used for special list entries
Reintroduced theme support
Added experimental support for downloading Amiibo images
Intended for use with Overlay
To enable manually edit the Amiigo config file to set saveAmiiboImages to true
Note: There is a known issue with Overlay where loading images which are too large will cause it to crash. In future versions of Amiigo I will resize images automatically to prevent this.
Removed AmiiboAPI downloading functionality
AmiiboAPI is shutting down on Dec 31st 2025
Amiigo will no longer attempt to download the API data on first launch
The "Update API cache" button has been removed since it will stop working once the API goes offline
Sanitised file paths when creating virtual Amiibos to fix a bug where certain Amiibos were uncreatable
Updated included API cache
Updated to latest Arriba
Changes to Arriba:

Fixed double text kerning bug
Added support for most unicode characters
